# laws { #gambeta.laws }

`laws`

pandera schemas: the contract between pipeline layers.

Every Parquet write validates against a schema here, and every read validates
again. An identity-resolution bug therefore surfaces as a loud failure at the
layer boundary rather than as a subtly wrong chart three layers downstream.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [CROSSWALK](#gambeta.laws.CROSSWALK) | Wikidata identity crosswalk, one row per person. |
| [ELO](#gambeta.laws.ELO) | Team strength snapshot, one row per (season, team). |
| [EXTRA_COMP](#gambeta.laws.EXTRA_COMP) | One row per (player, season, competition) outside the domestic league. |
| [KEEPER_RAW](#gambeta.laws.KEEPER_RAW) | Goalkeeper season table. Separate population, separate requirements. |
| [LEAGUE_OFFSETS](#gambeta.laws.LEAGUE_OFFSETS) | League-strength offsets in z units, with the number of transfers behind each. |
| [OUTFIELD_RAW](#gambeta.laws.OUTFIELD_RAW) | `standard` joined with the shooting, playing-time and misc tables. |
| [PLAYER_SEASON](#gambeta.laws.PLAYER_SEASON) | One row per (player_id, season). Mid-season transfers collapsed. |
| [PLAYER_SEASON_RAW](#gambeta.laws.PLAYER_SEASON_RAW) | One row per (season, team, player), exactly as scraped. Transfers duplicate. |
| [RANKING](#gambeta.laws.RANKING) | Gate-and-rank output. |
| [RATING](#gambeta.laws.RATING) | Lens output: one row per player with a point estimate and interval. |
| [ValidationError](#gambeta.laws.ValidationError) | Catch-all for schema violations. |
